agent.instructions: Pick the agent that should handle the customer's current WhatsApp message. Prefer the active agent if the message still fits it; switch if it clearly belongs to another agent.

GreetAgentWA.what: Greetings, hello/hi texts, emojis, and generic fallback openers

ChitChatAgent.what: Casual, non-actionable talk or emotional venting with no specific order, product, or support task
ChitChatAgent.not_for: Any concrete request to track, cancel, refund, modify, return, or reach a human

PreOrderFAQAgentWA.what: Pre-purchase and policy questions: COD, coupons, product questions, collaborations, legitimacy/scam concerns, and HOW-TO/policy questions about returns, refunds, exchanges or cancellations
PreOrderFAQAgentWA.not_for: Actually cancelling an order (CancellationAgentWA), checking a refund's status (RefundAgentWA), or reporting a damaged/returned item (PostDeliveryAgentWA)
examples: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
Is Zop legit or a scam?
how do I return your product?

OrderTrackingAgentWA.what: Where an order is, its status, delays, or delivery time

CancellationAgentWA.what: Requests to cancel an order, or why/when/how an order was cancelled
examples: I want to cancel my order

OrderModiferAgentWA.what: Modifying an existing order: address change, delivery-location change, or changing the ordered item

RefundAgentWA.what: Status of a refund or money not yet received back
examples: when will I get my money back

PostDeliveryAgentWA.what: Problems with a delivered order: returns, exchanges, wrong/damaged/missing items, quality or warranty

ConnectAgentWA.what: ONLY an explicit request to speak with a human agent
ConnectAgentWA.not_for: Any topic where the customer has not directly asked for a human; never as a follow-up to another issue
examples: I want to talk to a human
let me speak to a real person
